description: This file contains unit tests for the DataElement and related classes in the WPEFramework Core namespace. It tests functionalities such as copying, size management, CRC calculation, searching, bit setting, and parsing of DataElement objects, as well as linked data operations.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Represents a data element with copy, size, CRC, search, set/get number functionalities, and bit manipulations.

classes.name: DataStore
classes.description: A storage container for data, with copy and size management methods.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: A linked list node of DataElements supporting buffer operations and linked list management.

classes.name: DataElementParser
classes.description: Parses DataElement objects for size, validation, and byte skipping.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data into the DataElement or DataStore objects.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Gets or sets the size of DataElement or DataStore.

methods.name: CRC32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum for the DataElement.

methods.name: SearchNumber
methods.description: Searches for a number within DataElement with specified endianness.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a number within DataElement at a specified position.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for a sequence within DataElement.

methods.name: SetBitNumber
methods.description: Sets a bit number within DataElement.

methods.name: GetBitNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a bit number from DataElement.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a value at an offset within DataElement.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns the DataElement to a specific boundary.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Gets the size of the DataElement or linked list.

methods.name: SkipBytes
methods.description: Skips a number of bytes during parsing.
